title: The double-dual morphism under a proper push-forward
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of separated finite-type
schemes over a field, and use finite coefficients invertible there.
On the ambient etale derived categories let
$\omega_T=Ra_T^{\times}A$ and
$D_T=R\mathcal Hom_A(-,\omega_T)$. For every complex $K$,
the ambient exchange $D_YRf_*\cong Rf_*D_X$ identifies
$Rf_*\delta_K$ with $\delta_{Rf_*K}$. In particular, if the
latter is an isomorphism then so is the former.
Neither exceptional-adjoint admissibility on a constructible
subcategory nor geometric biduality is assumed.

proof.text: Retain the explicit proper shriek/star isomorphism and compact-support composition mate. Transport the exceptional adjunction by properAmbientShriekStarIso, and evaluate the mate at the coefficient unit to obtain properAmbientDualizingIso. Its inverse and exceptional counit give the trace.

Use the canonical monoidal derived pullback and its proved compatibility with descended braiding. The right adjoint is lax braided by Adjunction.rightAdjointLaxBraidedOfδ. The old projection-then-counit product is its lax product by product_eq_laxProduct and rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_app_app.

Use the existing MonoidalClosed.dualComparison. The proved elementary helper dualComparison_eq_curry identifies it with the transpose of the pushed-forward signed evaluation followed by trace. The helper doubleDual_eq_transpose verifies the canonical toIhomIhom normalization. The canonical Koszul swap interchanges the factors and is its own inverse.

The existing unbounded finite proper projection theorem makes every component invertible. Apply Adjunction.isIso_dualComparison_of_isIso_projection with the transported exceptional adjunction and the inverse dualizing isomorphism. This uses the canonical internal-adjunction argument already proved in DoubleDualProper, not a new isomorphism chosen from existence.

Naturality follows by expanding dualComparison and applying naturality of the internal-Hom comparison and pre_comm_ihom_map. The existing map_toIhomIhom_comp_dualComparison proves the square before inverting either exchange. The existing isIso_map_toIhomIhom_iff, with exchange at K and its dual, proves the final implication. Package exactly these four clauses generically before specializing, avoiding expensive reductions of derived-Hom instances.
